name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd
title: PNB Housing Finance Ltd - 540173 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Housing finance with no capacity signal; spread fell 10 bps to 2.12% on yield cuts, GNPA 0.93% and negative credit cost carry FY27 ROA guide of 2.4-2.5% (down from 2.66%).

triggers.label: Spread down 10 bps to 2.12%
triggers.quote: spread reduced by 10 bps Q -o-Q from 2.22 % to 2.12% due to lower incremental yield and BT pressure in prime business

triggers.label: Affordable yield 11.35% amid intense competition
triggers.quote: there was intense competition in terms of pricing especially in the last quarter in the market

triggers.label: FY27 ROA guide 2.4-2.5% vs 2.66%
triggers.quote: ROA would be in the range of 2.4% to 2.5%

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements up 36% YoY
triggers.quote: The disbursement during Q4 grew by 36% Y -o-Y and 50% Q-o-Q to INR 9,355 crores

triggers.label: Yield bottomed; BT-outs 8.6% in Q4 vs 8.95% Q3
triggers.quote: Q4 has actually improved from Q3. Q3 it was 8.95%

guidance.quote: We are looking for loan book to cross more than INR 1 lakh crores mark in FY’27.
Retail loan book projected to grow between 18% to 20%.
NIM would be in the range of 3.55% to 3.65%.
ROA would be in the range of 2.4% to 2.5%.
we still expect the credit cost to remain negative next year in t he range of around 15 to 20 bps.
We expect it to remain range bound between 1% to 1.1%.
it will not be more than 3% of my overall book in the FY’27

red_flags.label: Q4 NIM up while spread down; methodology explanation
red_flags.quote: This one -off inverse relationship between spread and NIM is due to difference in methodology.

red_flags.label: Affordable disbursement challenges mid-year
red_flags.quote: there were some challenges which we faced during mid of the year which we corrected

evasions.quote: No, I think disbursal was not in slow pace.
No specific reason, if you see year-on-year it is stable.
